name: Cabo Verde
build: built: Constituição da República de Cabo Verde (3 versions, 1999-11-23 to 2010-05-03, from the Boletim Oficial republications and the 2000 rectification); the 1992 and 1995 texts (scans) and the 2010 rectification (not found) are missing; Código Penal (Decreto-Legislativo 4/2003, as enacted, in force 2004-07-01; later amendments not applied); Código de Processo Penal (Decreto-Legislativo 2/2005, as enacted, in force 2005-10-01; later amendments not applied); Código Laboral (Decreto-Legislativo 5/2007, as enacted, in force 2008-04-13; later amendments not applied)
